---
title: "Projects"
listing:
    id: posts
    contents: posts
    sort: "date desc"
    template: _extensions/custom-listing/gallery.ejs
    categories: true
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [title, date, categories, image, description, subtitle]
    max-description-length: 300
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
---

::: {#timeline .timeline-container}
:::

```{=html}
<style>
.project-filter-container {
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.project-filter-bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
}

.project-filter-btn {
  font-family: "Chicago", "Monaco", monospace;
  font-size: 12px;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  color: #000000;
  border: 2px solid #000000;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  transition: all 0.1s ease;
  user-select: none;
}

.project-filter-btn:hover {
  transform: translate(-1px, -1px);
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.project-filter-btn.active {
  background-color: #000000;
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: none;
  transform: translate(1px, 1px);
}
</style>

<div class="project-filter-container">
  <div class="project-filter-bar" role="tablist" aria-label="Project categories">
    <button class="project-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">All</button>
    <button class="project-filter-btn" data-filter="Active PhD Research">Active PhD Research</button>
    <button class="project-filter-btn" data-filter="Visualizations & Apps">Visualizations &amp; Apps</button>
    <button class="project-filter-btn" data-filter="Talks">Talks</button>
    <button class="project-filter-btn" data-filter="Essays">Essays</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const timeline = document.querySelector('.timeline-container');
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-card[data-date]');
  if (!cards.length) return;

  function buildTimeline() {
    if (!timeline) return;
    timeline.innerHTML = '';
    
    // Only build timeline for visible cards
    const visibleCards = Array.from(cards).filter(c => c.style.display !== 'none');
    const dateMap = new Map();
    
    visibleCards.forEach(card => {
      const dateStr = card.getAttribute('data-date');
      if (dateStr && !dateMap.has(dateStr)) {
        const date = new Date(dateStr);
        dateMap.set(dateStr, {
          date,
          year: date.getFullYear(),
          month: date.toLocaleString('en', { month: 'short' })
        });
      }
    });

    const sortedEntries = Array.from(dateMap.entries())
      .sort((a, b) => b[1].date - a[1].date);

    sortedEntries.forEach(([dateStr, dateInfo]) => {
      const timelineItem = document.createElement('div');
      timelineItem.className = 'timeline-item';
      timelineItem.setAttribute('data-date', dateStr);
      timelineItem.innerHTML = `<span class="timeline-year">${dateInfo.year}</span><span class="timeline-month">${dateInfo.month}</span>`;

      timelineItem.addEventListener('click', function() {
        const card = document.querySelector(`.gallery-card[data-date="${dateStr}"]`);
        if (card) {
          card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        }
      });

      timeline.appendChild(timelineItem);
    });
  }

  function updateActive() {
    if (!timeline) return;
    const items = timeline.querySelectorAll('.timeline-item');
    items.forEach(item => item.classList.remove('active'));

    const visibleCards = Array.from(cards).filter(c => c.style.display !== 'none');
    for (let card of visibleCards) {
      const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.top < window.innerHeight * 0.6 && rect.bottom > window.innerHeight * 0.4) {
        const dateStr = card.getAttribute('data-date');
        const activeItem = timeline.querySelector(`.timeline-item[data-date="${dateStr}"]`);
        if (activeItem) {
          activeItem.classList.add('active');
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Segment filter button click handling
  const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.project-filter-btn');
  filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      this.classList.add('active');
      const selected = this.getAttribute('data-filter');

      cards.forEach(card => {
        if (selected === 'all') {
          card.style.display = '';
        } else {
          const cardCats = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('.listing-category')).map(c => c.textContent.trim());
          if (cardCats.includes(selected)) {
            card.style.display = '';
          } else {
            card.style.display = 'none';
          }
        }
      });

      buildTimeline();
      updateActive();
    });
  });

  buildTimeline();
  window.addEventListener('scroll', updateActive);
  updateActive();

  // Category deselect on second click in Quarto sidebar
  function attachCategoryToggle() {
    const listingEl = document.getElementById('posts');
    const categoryBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-listing-category .category');

    function showAllItems() {
      const allItems = listingEl
        ? listingEl.querySelectorAll('[data-listing-categories], .gallery-card, .gallery-card-compact')
        : document.querySelectorAll('[data-listing-categories], .gallery-card, .gallery-card-compact');
      allItems.forEach(el => {
        el.style.removeProperty('display');
        const li = el.closest('li');
        if (li) li.style.removeProperty('display');
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-listing-category]').forEach(el => {
        el.style.removeProperty('display');
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.listing-no-matching').forEach(el => {
        el.style.display = 'none';
      });
      buildTimeline();
      updateActive();
    }

    categoryBtns.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        const wasActive = this.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' ||
                          this.classList.contains('active');
        if (wasActive) {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(() => {
            const anyActive = [...categoryBtns].some(b =>
              b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' || b.classList.contains('active')
            );
            if (!anyActive) {
              showAllItems();
            } else {
              buildTimeline();
              updateActive();
            }
          }, 0));
        } else {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(() => {
            buildTimeline();
            updateActive();
          }, 0));
        }
      });
    });
  }

  (function waitForCategories(attempts) {
    const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-listing-category .category');
    if (btns.length > 0) {
      attachCategoryToggle();
    } else if (attempts > 0) {
      setTimeout(() => waitForCategories(attempts - 1), 100);
    }
  })(20);
});
</script>
```
